title: Fireball Thrower Enchantment
description: This mod adds an enchantment that allows you to shoot fireballs
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94f91986f0b5c8f6dd1fd88abf8b01ff98b30951.png)
[![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Discord-Button-64.png)](https://discord.gg/hFS6faY9tW) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Modrinth-Button-64.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fireball-thrower-enchantment)
This mod adds a new enchantment that allows you to throw fireball from weapons. You can obtain it from loot or villager trades. ![Using the enchantment](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/440c532ca48a8f17154dd4e2fce6a7ca1c1b5c51_0.webp) Once you've applied the enchantment to one of your weapons, right-click while holding it in your main hand and you'll throw a fireball! Created using [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/).
